after.definition:
SELECT n.id,
    n.script_version_id,
    n.updated_at,
    n.sort_order,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(e.key, e.value), '{}'::jsonb) AS "coalesce"
           FROM jsonb_each(
                CASE
                    WHEN (jsonb_typeof(n.teacher_script) = 'object'::text) THEN n.teacher_script
                    ELSE '{}'::jsonb
                END) e(key, value)
          WHERE ((e.key = ANY (ARRAY['zh-CN'::text, 'ko-KR'::text])) AND (jsonb_typeof(e.value) = 'string'::text))) AS teacher_script,
    private.student_script_segments(n.teacher_script, (n.configuration -> 'scriptSegments'::text)) AS segments,
        CASE
            WHEN (((n.configuration -> 'teacherVideo'::text) ->> 'mode'::text) = 'video'::text) THEN 'video'::text
            ELSE 'legacy'::text
        END AS video_mode
   FROM ((public.learning_agent_script_nodes n
     JOIN public.learning_agent_script_versions v ON ((v.id = n.script_version_id)))
     JOIN public.learning_agent_lessons l ON ((l.id = v.lesson_id)))
  WHERE ((auth.uid() IS NOT NULL) AND (v.status = 'published'::text) AND (l.status = 'published'::text) AND private.can_read_published_teaching_module(l.module_id));
